answer: Require every identity to lock a 170-unit refundable bond for twelve epochs. Each epoch assigns one random task and requires three attestations from peers with no shared recent contacts; copied wording, reused proofs, or synchronized timing freezes the bond for four epochs. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, peer independence, and time windows. Each sybil alias locks 170 units and repeats twelve rounds, while echo patterns expose coordination; nadir penalties deter collusion, and river assignments keep honest work varied.
